item.title: Who Am I?
item.description:
I am Miles Hilliard, a passionate student at Medford Vocational Technical High School (MVTHS) in Medford, MA. I specialize in hands on work, with a growing passion for programming, electrical engineering, artificial intelligence, and robotic autonomy

As a self-proclaimed expert in problem solving, I have have been working with ROVs at Sunk Robotics for four years now as the lead electrical engineer where I help design, develop, and test innovative underwater ROVs for the annual MATE ROV competition. Learn more.
